==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am working for a secret organization. We investigate anomalous phenomenon. I am in charge of reviewing field data.

We've recently discovered floating black orbs. These orbs are quite large, but rarely noticed. They appear to be made of several panels of ethereal material.

The orbs create danger zones below them. These danger zones can trigger a variety of effects on those who walk through them. I still don't understand what the orbs are, or why they're creating these zones.
